description: Rows of the CodeMeta 3.1 mapping export that do not read their crosswalk cell: the cell is prose, empty, wrong, or the format has no crosswalk. 'cell' is the crosswalk cell the row was written for, left out when the format has no crosswalk; when the cell changes the row is reported as CURATED_STALE. 'reason' becomes the row's source as curated:<reason>. Format: docs/mapping-export.md.

rows.reason: the cell lists person.orcid / identifiers / doi; a person's ORCID is orcid
the cell lists license / license-url; license-url holds a licence URL, not an SPDX id
the cell lists identifiers / person.orcid / doi; the software DOI is doi, or the doi entry of identifiers
the cell lists identifiers / person.orcid / doi; a SWHID is the swh entry of identifiers
CodeMeta has no SWHID term; a SWHID sits in identifier, beside the DOI, as a swh:1: string or a PropertyValue (propertyID SWHID) whose value is one

rows.comment: The GitHub integration mints the DOI and normally leaves doi unset in .zenodo.json.

rows.reason: the cell says id, the Zenodo record id; a SWHID is the identifier of the related_identifiers entry with scheme swh
rows.comment: scheme is optional: Zenodo detects it from the identifier. Also read an entry with no scheme whose identifier starts swh:1: as the SWHID.

rows.reason: the cell says related_identifiers.isSupplementTo, a relation, not a key; the URL is the identifier of the entry with that relation
